description: This file defines the WebToLeadFormBuilder class responsible for generating an HTML form for web-based lead submission in a CRM application. It includes methods for constructing different parts of the form, handling various input types, and integrating with CRM-specific configurations and data structures.

classes.name: WebToLeadFormBuilder
classes.description: A utility class to generate customizable HTML forms for lead capture in the CRM system.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to produce the complete HTML form based on input parameters, CRM lead field definitions, and configuration flags.
